comparison.objective: Position, unfold, level, and switch on a foldable desk lamp; unlike commissioning an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate a free base and three passive hinges, orient a shade, and toggle a switch rather than engage a recessed setscrew and tune damping.
comparison.success_condition: Base contained in frame, shade at least 20 cm high, light face within 15 degrees of horizontal, lamp on. Candidate uses dynamic cycles and retention testing.
comparison.reason: Articulated object configuration is not equivalent to iterative mechanical calibration.
